newsitem.title: USA: Penske to buy land near Calif. Speedway.
newsitem.headline: Penske to buy land near Calif. Speedway.

text.p: Penske Motorsports Inc said Friday it will acquire about 54 acres of land adjacent to the California Speedway from Kaiser Ventures Inc for $13.4 million, or about $5.67 per square foot.
Upon consummation of the transaction, Kaiser will receive $5 million in cash and about 254,000 shares of Penske's common stock valued at $8.4 million.
The transaction is scheduled to close during the fourth quarter. The agreement expands Penske's California Speedway property to 529 acres from 475 acres.

Richard Stoddard, Kaiser's chairman, said in a statement the sale of the 54-acre property, known as Speedway Business Park, for cash and stock, fits with the company's strategy to convert its underutilized assets into growing businesses.
Penske promotes and markets professional motorsports in the United States. California Speedway is under construction near Los Angeles, Calif.
